core.title: Falcon H Series Interconnect Lever and Deadbolt, H101D630

text.description_html:
Falcon H101D630

Entry/Single Lock Latch bolt operated by knob or lever from either side. Rotating turn from inside or key from outside extends dead bolt. Dead bolt and latch bolt retract by rotating inside knob or lever.

Standard Features - Furnished unless otherwise specified

  • UL Listed for 1-1/2-Hour fire door
  • 1-1/8" x 2-1/4", Square corner faceplate
  • 1/2" throw 1-1/8" x 2-3/4" lipless and 1-1/8" x 2-3/4" T strike
  • 6-Pin, Solid brass, Keyed 5-Pin, Falcon G keyway
  • Backset: either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Finish: Satin Stainless
